sourceSentences: [0] If you get a chance to close the gap and fight him, make sure you do it inside of the minion wave so that his Q isn't isolated. It does way more damage if you don't have a minion next to you.

[0] Just make sure you walk away after your E is on cool down since his auto attacks and passive have no cool down. His passive gives him a little bit of move speed after he activates it. So make sure you're not too far up when he's about to activate it.
[0] Make sure you track his Q and his E cool down after he uses it so that you know exactly when you can walk in and out.
[0] You can get these kinds of nice short trades, but he does still have that innate strength where he's really good in long trades.
[0] Make sure you do not fight through his W shield unless you're confident you can kill him through it.
[0] Morichiser is a spooky champion, but at level one, he is very much fightable.
[0] Post level six is where things really start to get scary. Verticiser has an insane all-in tool, which is his R
[0] His death realm can be used as gank setup as well. He doesn't even need to have his W stacked up. He can just R you and then just kind of stand there and wait for his jungler to be on top of you.
[0] Another scary part is that all it takes is for him to get one pull and then you're in a situation where you might have to flash or pretty much just die
[0] So, make sure you are always checking what his range will be if he's nearby.
[1] We're just going to try to pressure him very hard in the early game before he gets level six.
[1] You have to play this aggressive guys in the early game against Mika cuz trust me, if he gets level six without you having a lead, it becomes one of the hardest matchups in the game.
[1] Thing is, he doesn't have alt anymore. I think his alt is one of the longest cooldowns abilities in the game.
[1] He does have his ultimate here. I have to kite away.
